value.name: man admits taking the folder
value.description: After being pressed, the man finally admits that he took the folder.

value.name: man identifies where he took folder
value.description: He specifies that he took the folder from the bottom right drawer in the sewing room desk.
evidence: "From the bottom right drawer of the desk in the sewing room."

value.name: man gives time of theft
value.description: He states that he took the folder on the morning of February twenty-third around six fifteen while Rosa was downstairs.
evidence: "On the morning of February twenty-third. At approximately six fifteen in the morning. While Rosa was downstairs."
value.time_hint: morning of February twenty-third, approximately six fifteen in the morning

value.name: man explains motive for taking folder
value.description: He says he took the folder because he already knew what was in it.
evidence: "Because I knew what was in it."

value.name: woman learns he was told about contents
value.description: Lucia reacts in surprise when he reveals that Rosa had told him about the folder's contents.

value.name: Rosa confesses by phone
value.description: Daniel recounts that Rosa called him on February eleventh and confessed she had done something, then told him what she had done.
evidence: "She told me on the eleventh of February. She called me on the phone. She said *Daniel, I have done something and I want you to hear it from me first.* And she told me."

value.name: Daniel repeats accusations against others
value.description: Daniel says he responded to Rosa's confession by repeating the excuses and accusations she expected him to make about confusion, Rosa, and Lucia.
evidence: "And I said — I said all the things she said in the letter I would say. I said she was confused. I said Rosa had taken advantage of her. I said Lucia had been working on her. I said all of it."

value.name: Rosa accepts Daniel's response
value.description: Rosa lets Daniel finish his denials and then tells him she loves him and has done what she has done before hanging up.
evidence: "And when I was done she said, *Daniel, I love you, and I have done what I have done.* And she hung up."

value.name: Daniel visits house after confession
value.description: Daniel says he went to the house the following Saturday and had lunch with Rosa without mentioning the codicil.
evidence: "I went to the house the following Saturday. I sat at this table and ate lunch with her and I did not say anything about the codicil and neither did she."
